name: Benjamin Lavoie
bio: Benjamin Lavoie is a Hungarian-Canadian writer & director currently based in Toronto.

credits.title: Volatile
credits.overview: A group of film students make an investigative documentary on an elusive serial killer.

credits.title: Bonkey: The Mutated
credits.overview: An alien disease spreads like wildfire infecting a chain of unsuspecting victims. A man and his dog are all that stand in the way of containing the danger.

credits.title: Where We Left Off
credits.overview: A survivor and a terminally ill friend take refuge during the apocalypse. When faced with the choice to keep running or finally stop, they must confront their fears, grief and mortality.

credits.title: a short film about loss
credits.overview: A tribute to the feelings brought on by loss, and to those no longer with us.

credits.title: Blue Valley: Police Inquiry
credits.overview: A public police inquiry into the death of Andrew Jones in the small town of Blue Valley.

credits.title: You Cannot Speak
credits.overview: A woman finds herself in a room with a mysterious box.

credits.title: Maple Leaf Dreams
credits.overview: It is the story of Macky and Molly, a young, poor couple who work as a restaurant manager and an office secretary. Although they have decent jobs in the Philippines, they soon realize that their current routine won't give them a promising future in their home country. So, Molly applies for a student program in Canada.

credits.title: Dinner
credits.overview: Johnny is extremely nervous to meet his girlfriends parents for the first time. Once there, he realizes making a good first impression may be the least of his worries.

credits.title: The Alley
credits.overview: A short film made for The Jumpscare Project at Toronto Film School.

credits.overview: Grace is excited for the summer so she can start a business with her friends, but things take an unexpected turn when her mom announces a trip to Paris.
